sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Pranshu Dwivedi,Ram Prakash Dwivedi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.844 of 2018, under sections 498A, 420, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Tajganj,
District Agra, during the pendency of trial.

It is submitted that in this case applicant being bua sas of the informant was named in the F.I.R.
with false allegations alongwith other members of the family of the informant who were her jeth, sas and sasur regarding molestation by devar and harassment by other members.
After investigation charge sheet was also submitted by the police.

It is also submitted that as per the allegation in F.I.R.
present applicant did not take care of complaint made by the informant regarding her grievance and there is no any other allegation against the applicant.

Now after submission of charge sheet in Smt Rambeti vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42061167/
1 pursuance of the process of the court the applicant is under apprehension of arrest so requested for anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Smt Rambeti vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case she is released on bail, she would not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate with the trial.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and perusal of record and without making any comment on the merits of the case, the applicant is entitled to be released on anticipatory bail in this case during the pendency of trial.
In the event of arrest of the applicant- Smt Rambeti, shall be released on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 25,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the learned court everyday when case is fixed unless exempted;
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police office;
(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if she has passport, the same shall be deposited by her before the S.S.P./S.P.
concerned.
In default of any of the conditions, this order will automatically stand vacated.

Order Date :- 20.3.2023 Ashok Gupta  Smt Rambeti vs State Of U.P. And Another on 20 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/42061167/
